conceptPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single wide 16:9 environment concept for a side-view card-battle game. Create a BRAND NEW minimalist hand-painted 2D battle scene: an abandoned urban rail platform in winter. Simplicity is the main requirement. Build the whole image from a few broad, connected, opaque color masses, restrained hard edges, almost no small detail. Three readable depth planes: a quiet distant silhouette of only a few block-shaped buildings; a simple broken platform canopy framing the upper corners; a very broad, empty, snow-dusted concrete fighting platform across the center and lower half. The horizontal standing area is unobstructed and easy to read, with a consistent ground plane for characters to be added later. Reserve the central 70 percent of the width for combat; place the few structural shapes near the edges. Low-contrast cold ash-grey and charcoal with one small muted warm amber station light. Large calm snow shapes, sparse brushwork, no detailed rubble, no many cables, no dense falling snow, no scratches or all-over texture. A clear, calm, economical painted composition, stylized rather than realistic or 3D. No characters, enemies, cards, UI, text, signs, logos, watermarks, borders, or multiple panels. One complete landscape image.
